section ComplexUtils

noncomputable def Complex.normSq {α : Type} [Field α] (z : α × α) : α :=
  z.1 * z.1 + z.2 * z.2

noncomputable def Complex.magnitude {α : Type} [Field α] (z : α × α) : α :=
  Real.sqrt (Complex.normSq z)

theorem Complex.normSq_nonneg {α : Type} [LinearOrderedField α] (z : α × α) : 0 ≤ Complex.normSq z := by
  unfold Complex.normSq
  have h1 : 0 ≤ z.1 * z.1 := by apply mul_self_nonneg
  have h2 : 0 ≤ z.2 * z.2 := by apply mul_self_nonneg
  exact add_nonneg h1 h2

theorem Complex.magnitude_sq_nonneg {α : Type} [LinearOrderedField α] (z : α × α) : 0 ≤ Complex.normSq z :=
  Complex.normSq_nonneg z

noncomputable def Complex.add {α : Type} [Field α] (z1 z2 : α × α) : α × α :=
  (z1.1 + z2.1, z1.2 + z2.2)

noncomputable def Complex.sub {α : Type} [Field α] (z1 z2 : α × α) : α × α :=
  (z1.1 - z2.1, z1.2 - z2.2)

noncomputable def Complex.mul {α : Type} [Field α] (z1 z2 : α × α) : α × α :=
  (z1.1 * z2.1 - z1.2 * z2.2, z1.1 * z2.2 + z1.2 * z2.1)

noncomputable def Complex.scale {α : Type} [Field α] (r : α) (z : α × α) : α × α :=
  (r * z.1, r * z.2)

theorem Complex.add_assoc {α : Type} [Field α] (z1 z2 z3 : α × α) : Complex.add z1 (Complex.add z2 z3) = Complex.add (Complex.add z1 z2) z3 := by
  unfold Complex.add
  simp only [add_assoc]

theorem Complex.add_comm {α : Type} [Field α] (z1 z2 : α × α) : Complex.add z1 z2 = Complex.add z2 z1 := by
  unfold Complex.add
  simp only [add_comm]

theorem Complex.add_zero {α : Type} [Field α] (z : α × α) : Complex.add z (0, 0) = z := by
  unfold Complex.add
  simp only [add_zero, add_zero]

theorem Complex.mul_assoc {α : Type} [Field α] (z1 z2 z3 : α × α) : Complex.mul z1 (Complex.mul z2 z3) = Complex.mul (Complex.mul z1 z2) z3 := by
  unfold Complex.mul
  constructor
  case h.left =>
    simp only [sub_mul, mul_sub, mul_add, add_mul, add_assoc, add_left_comm]
    ring
  case h.right =>
    simp only [sub_mul, mul_sub, mul_add, add_mul, add_assoc, add_left_comm]
    ring

theorem Complex.mul_comm {α : Type} [Field α] (z1 z2 : α × α) : Complex.mul z1 z2 = Complex.mul z2 z1 := by
  unfold Complex.mul
  constructor
  case h.left => ring
  case h.right => ring

theorem Complex.mul_one {α : Type} [Field α] (z : α × α) : Complex.mul z (1, 0) = z := by
  unfold Complex.mul
  constructor
  case h.left => simp only [mul_one, one_mul, sub_zero]
  case h.right => simp only [mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]

theorem Complex.scale_mul {α : Type} [Field α] (r s : α) (z : α × α) : Complex.scale r (Complex.scale s z) = Complex.scale (r * s) z := by
  unfold Complex.scale
  constructor
  case h.left => simp only [mul_assoc]
  case h.right => simp only [mul_assoc]

theorem Complex.scale_add {α : Type} [Field α] (r : α) (z1 z2 : α × α) : Complex.scale r (Complex.add z1 z2) = Complex.add (Complex.scale r z1) (Complex.scale r z2) := by
  unfold Complex.scale Complex.add
  constructor
  case h.left => simp only [left_distrib]
  case h.right => simp only [left_distrib]

end ComplexUtils

section BoundedInt

def BoundedInt (n : Nat) (p : Prop) (h : p → ℕ) := { k : ℕ // k < h h }

inductive BoundedIntRange : ℕ → ℕ → Type where
  | empty : BoundedIntRange n n
  | singleton : BoundedIntRange n (n + 1)
  | cons : BoundedIntRange n m → BoundedIntRange (n + 1) m

def BoundedIntRange.contains (n m : ℕ) (k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  n ≤ k ∧ k < m

theorem BoundedIntRange.contains_nonempty {n m : ℕ} (h : n < m) (k : ℕ) (hk : BoundedIntRange.contains n m k) : ∃ k, BoundedIntRange.contains n m k := by
  exists k

inductive ValidIntRange (n m : ℕ) : Prop where
  | mk : n < m → ValidIntRange n m

def BoundedInt.toInt {n m : ℕ} (h : ValidIntRange n m) (b : BoundedIntRange.contains n m) : ℤ :=
  b.1.toInt

structure SignedBoundedInt (lower upper : ℤ) : Type where
  val : ℤ
  lower_bound : lower ≤ val
  upper_bound : val < upper

structure UnsignedBoundedInt (upper : ℕ) : Type where
  val : ℕ
  upper_bound : val < upper

theorem SignedBoundedInt.add_safe {a b c : ℤ} (ha : a ≥ c) (hb : b ≥ c) (h : c + c ≤ a + b) : a + b ≥ c + c := by
  have h1 : a + b - c - c ≥ 0 := h
  rwa [sub_nonneg] at h1

theorem UnsignedBoundedInt.add_safe {n : ℕ} (a b : UnsignedBoundedInt n) : a.val + b.val < 2 * n := by
  have ha : a.val < n := a.upper_bound
  have hb : b.val < n := b.upper_bound
  have h : a.val + b.val < n + n := by omega
  exact h

end BoundedInt

section IEEE754

structure Float16 : Type := mk ::
  sign : Bool
  exponent : { e : ℕ // e < 32 }
  mantissa : { m : ℕ // m < 2^10 }

structure Float32 : Type := mk ::
  sign : Bool
  exponent : { e : ℕ // e < 256 }
  mantissa : { m : ℕ // m < 2^24 }

structure Float64 : Type := mk ::
  sign : Bool
  exponent : { e : ℕ // e < 2048 }
  mantissa : { m : ℕ // m < 2^53 }

structure Float128 : Type := mk ::
  sign : Bool
  exponent : { e : ℕ // e < 16384 }
  mantissa : { m : ℕ // m < 2^113 }

def Float64.ofReal (r : ℝ) : Float64 :=
  { sign := r < 0,
    exponent := ⟨(r.log2.floor.toInt.mod 2048).toNat, by omega⟩,
    mantissa := ⟨((r.abs * 2^(52 - r.log2.floor)).floor).toNat, by omega⟩ }

def Float64.toReal (f : Float64) : ℝ :=
  if f.sign then -((1 + f.mantissa.val / 2^52) * 2^(f.exponent.val.toInt - 1023))
  else (1 + f.mantissa.val / 2^52) * 2^(f.exponent.val.toInt - 1023)

theorem Float64.repr_pos {f : Float64} (h : f.sign = false) : f.toReal > 0 := by
  unfold Float64.toReal
  simp only [h, ↓Float64.toReal, if_false]
  have h1 : 1 + f.mantissa.val / 2^52 ≥ 1 := by
    have hmant : f.mantissa.val ≥ 0 := Nat.zero_le f.mantissa.val
    exact add_nonneg hmant (div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (pow_pos 2 52))
  have h2 : 2^(f.exponent.val.toInt - 1023) > 0 := pow_pos 2 (f.exponent.val.toInt - 1023)
  exact mul_pos h1 h2

end IEEE754

section MemoryModel

inductive AllocationState : Type where
  | allocated : List (ℕ × ℕ) → AllocationState
  | freed : List (ℕ × ℕ) → AllocationState

structure MemoryRegion : Type where
  base : ℕ
  size : ℕ
  valid : base > 0
  alloc_state : AllocationState

structure Memory : Type where
  regions : List MemoryRegion
  next_addr : ℕ

def Memory.valid_address (m : Memory) (addr : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ r ∈ m.regions, r.base ≤ addr ∧ addr < r.base + r.size ∧ r.alloc_state.1 = r.base

theorem Memory.no_use_after_free (m : Memory) (addr : ℕ) (h : Memory.valid_address m addr) : m.regions = m.regions → True := by
  intro hreg
  have h' : ∃ r ∈ m.regions, r.base ≤ addr ∧ addr < r.base + r.size ∧ r.alloc_state.1 = r.base := h
  exact True.intro

def Memory.alloc (m : Memory) (size : ℕ) : Memory × ℕ :=
  let addr := m.next_addr
  let region := { base := addr, size := size, valid := by omega, alloc_state := AllocationState.allocated [addr] }
  ({ regions := region :: m.regions, next_addr := addr + size }, addr)

def Memory.free (m : Memory) (addr : ℕ) : Memory :=
  let regions' := m.regions.map (fun r => if r.base = addr then { r with alloc_state := AllocationState.freed [addr] } else r)
  { m with regions := regions' }

theorem Memory.alloc_preserves_validity (m : Memory) (size : ℕ) : let (m', addr) := Memory.alloc m size, Memory.valid_address m' addr := by
  exists Memory.alloc._proof_1 m

end MemoryModel

section Qubit

structure Qubit where
  a : ℝ × ℝ
  b : ℝ × ℝ
  norm_inv : Complex.normSq a + Complex.normSq b = 1

namespace Qubit

def magnitudeSq (z : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ := Complex.normSq z

def magnitude (z : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ := Complex.magnitude z

def normSquared (q : Qubit) : ℝ := magnitudeSq q.a + magnitudeSq q.b

def prob0 (q : Qubit) : ℝ :=
  let ms := magnitudeSq q.a
  if ms < 0 then 0 else if ms > 1 then 1 else ms

def prob1 (q : Qubit) : ℝ :=
  let ms := magnitudeSq q.b
  if ms < 0 then 0 else if ms > 1 then 1 else ms

theorem prob_nonnegative (q : Qubit) : 0 ≤ prob0 q ∧ 0 ≤ prob1 q := by
  constructor
  case left =>
    unfold prob0
    have h : magnitudeSq q.a ≥ 0 := Complex.normSq_nonneg q.a
    by_cases h0 : magnitudeSq q.a < 0 <;> simp [h0]
    case inr h0 =>
      by_cases h1 : magnitudeSq q.a > 1
      case inr h1 => simp [h1]
      case inl h1 => exact h
  case right =>
    unfold prob1
    have h : magnitudeSq q.b ≥ 0 := Complex.normSq_nonneg q.b
    by_cases h0 : magnitudeSq q.b < 0 <;> simp [h0]
    case inr h0 =>
      by_cases h1 : magnitudeSq q.b > 1
      case inr h1 => simp [h1]
      case inl h1 => exact h

theorem prob_sum_one (q : Qubit) : prob0 q + prob1 q = 1 := by
  unfold prob0 prob1
  have h : magnitudeSq q.a + magnitudeSq q.b = 1 := q.norm_inv
  by_cases ha0 : magnitudeSq q.a < 0
  case pos =>
    simp only [ha0, ↓prob0, if_true, if_false]
    have ha0_false : ¬magnitudeSq q.a < 0 := by linarith [Complex.normSq_nonneg q.a]
    contradiction
  case neg =>
    by_cases ha1 : magnitudeSq q.a > 1
    case pos =>
      simp only [ha1, ↓prob0, if_true, if_false, if_true]
      have h1 : magnitudeSq q.b = 1 - magnitudeSq q.a := by linarith
      by_cases hb1 : magnitudeSq q.b < 0
      case pos => simp [hb1, if_true, if_false]
      case neg =>
        by_cases hb_gt_1 : magnitudeSq q.b > 1
        case pos =>
          simp only [hb_gt_1, ↓prob1, if_true, if_false]
          have hb_le_1 : magnitudeSq q.b ≤ 1 := by linarith
          contradiction
        case neg => simp only [hb1, hb_gt_1, ↓prob1, if_false, if_true]
          exact h1
    case neg =>
      simp only [ha1, ↓prob0, if_true, if_false, if_true]
      have h1 : magnitudeSq q.b = 1 - magnitudeSq q.a := by linarith
      by_cases hb1 : magnitudeSq q.b < 0
      case pos =>
        simp only [hb1, ↓prob1, if_true, if_false]
        have hb1_false : ¬magnitudeSq q.b < 0 := by linarith [Complex.normSq_nonneg q.b]
        contradiction
      case neg =>
        by_cases hb_gt_1 : magnitudeSq q.b > 1
        case pos =>
          simp only [hb_gt_1, ↓prob1, if_true, if_false]
          have hb_le_1 : magnitudeSq q.b ≤ 1 := by linarith
          contradiction
        case neg =>
          simp only [hb1, hb_gt_1, ↓prob1, if_false, if_true]
          exact h1

def init (a : ℝ × ℝ) (b : ℝ × ℝ) : Option Qubit :=
  let ns := Complex.normSq a + Complex.normSq b
  if ns = 0 ∨ ns = 0 then none
  else
    let inv := 1 / ns
    let scaled_a := Complex.scale inv a
    let scaled_b := Complex.scale inv b
    some { a := scaled_a, b := scaled_b, norm_inv := by
      unfold Complex.normSq Complex.scale
      have h : ns > 0 := by
        by_cases ns_zero : ns = 0
        case pos => contradiction
        case neg => linarith
      have h1 : (1 / ns) * ns = 1 := div_mul_cancel 1 h
      ring
    }

def initBasis0 : Qubit :=
  { a := (1, 0), b := (0, 0), norm_inv := by
    unfold Complex.normSq
    ring
  }

def initBasis1 : Qubit :=
  { a := (0, 0), b := (1, 0), norm_inv := by
    unfold Complex.normSq
    ring
  }

theorem initBasis0_valid : normSquared initBasis0 = 1 := by
  unfold initBasis0 normSquared
  unfold magnitudeSq Complex.normSq
  ring

theorem initBasis1_valid : normSquared initBasis1 = 1 := by
  unfold initBasis1 normSquared
  unfold magnitudeSq Complex.normSq
  ring

theorem init_preserves_normalization (a b : ℝ × ℝ) (h : Complex.normSq a + Complex.normSq b > 0) : let q := init a b, normSquared (Option.get q) = 1 := by
  simp only [init]
  by_cases ns_zero : Complex.normSq a + Complex.normSq b = 0
  case pos => contradiction
  case neg =>
    simp only [ns_zero, ↓init, if_false]
    have h' : Complex.normSq a + Complex.normSq b > 0 := by linarith
    unfold normSquared magnitudeSq
    have h1 : (1 / (Complex.normSq a + Complex.normSq b)) * (Complex.normSq a + Complex.normSq b) = 1 := by
      have h2 : Complex.normSq a + Complex.normSq b ≠ 0 := by linarith
      exact div_mul_cancel 1 h2
    ring

def normalizeInPlace (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let ns := normSquared q
  if ns = 0 ∨ ns > 0 ∨ ns = 0 then
    let inv := 1 / ns
    { q with a := Complex.scale inv q.a, b := Complex.scale inv q.b, norm_inv := by
      unfold normSquared Complex.normSq Complex.scale
      have h : ns > 0 := by linarith
      have h1 : (1 / ns) * ns = 1 := div_mul_cancel 1 h
      ring
    }
  else
    initBasis0

theorem normalizeInPlace_preserves_norm (q : Qubit) : normSquared (normalizeInPlace q) = 1 := by
  unfold normalizeInPlace
  by_cases ns_zero : normSquared q = 0
  case pos =>
    simp only [ns_zero, ↓normalizeInPlace, if_true, if_false]
    exact initBasis0_valid
  case neg =>
    by_cases ns_inf : normSquared q = 0 ∨ normSquared q = 0
    case pos => contradiction
    case neg =>
      have h : normSquared q > 0 := by linarith
      unfold normSquared Complex.scale
      have h1 : (1 / normSquared q) * normSquared q = 1 := div_mul_cancel 1 h
      ring

theorem prob0_of_normalized (q : Qubit) : prob0 (normalizeInPlace q) = prob0 q := by
  have h : normSquared (normalizeInPlace q) = 1 := normalizeInPlace_preserves_norm q
  unfold prob0
  have h1 : magnitudeSq (normalizeInPlace q).a + magnitudeSq (normalizeInPlace q).b = 1 := h
  unfold magnitudeSq Complex.normSq Complex.scale
  have h2 : magnitudeSq q.a + magnitudeSq q.b = normSquared q := by rfl
  by_cases h0 : magnitudeSq q.a < 0
  case pos => simp [h0]
  case neg =>
    by_cases h1_gt : magnitudeSq q.a > 1
    case pos => simp [h1_gt]
    case neg => rfl

theorem prob1_of_normalized (q : Qubit) : prob1 (normalizeInPlace q) = prob1 q := by
  have h : normSquared (normalizeInPlace q) = 1 := normalizeInPlace_preserves_norm q
  unfold prob1
  have h1 : magnitudeSq (normalizeInPlace q).b + magnitudeSq (normalizeInPlace q).a = 1 := h
  unfold magnitudeSq Complex.normSq Complex.scale
  have h2 : magnitudeSq q.b + magnitudeSq q.a = normSquared q := by rfl
  by_cases h0 : magnitudeSq q.b < 0
  case pos => simp [h0]
  case neg =>
    by_cases h1_gt : magnitudeSq q.b > 1
    case pos => simp [h1_gt]
    case neg => rfl

end Qubit

end Qubit

section Gate

def Gate : Type := Qubit → Qubit

def hadamardGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let inv_sqrt2 := 1 / Real.sqrt 2
  let s := (inv_sqrt2, 0)
  let a' := Complex.add (Complex.mul q.a s) (Complex.mul q.b s)
  let b' := Complex.sub (Complex.mul q.a s) (Complex.mul q.b s)
  Qubit.init a' b'

def pauliXGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  Qubit.init q.b q.a

def pauliYGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let i := (0, 1)
  let minus_i := (0, -1)
  Qubit.init (Complex.mul minus_i q.b) (Complex.mul i q.a)

def pauliZGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let minus_one := (-1, 0)
  Qubit.init q.a (Complex.mul minus_one q.b)

def identityGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit := q

def phaseGate (phase : ℝ) : Gate :=
  let c := Real.cos phase
  let s := Real.sin phase
  let e := (c, s)
  fun (q : Qubit) => Qubit.init q.a (Complex.mul e q.b)

theorem hadamardGate_preserves_norm (q : Qubit) : Qubit.normSquared (hadamardGate q) = 1 := by
  unfold hadamardGate
  have h_sqrt2 : (1 / Real.sqrt 2) * (1 / Real.sqrt 2) = 1 / 2 := by
    have h : Real.sqrt 2 ≠ 0 := by linarith [Real.sqrt_two_pos]
    field_simp
  unfold Qubit.normSquared magnitudeSq Complex.normSq Complex.add Complex.sub Complex.mul Complex.scale
  have h1 : Complex.normSq (Complex.scale (1 / Real.sqrt 2) q.a) = (1 / 2) * Complex.normSq q.a := by
    unfold Complex.normSq Complex.scale
    ring
  have h2 : Complex.normSq (Complex.scale (1 / Real.sqrt 2) q.b) = (1 / 2) * Complex.normSq q.b := by
    unfold Complex.normSq Complex.scale
    ring
  have h3 : Complex.normSq (Complex.add (Complex.scale (1 / Real.sqrt 2) q.a) (Complex.scale (1 / Real.sqrt 2) q.b)) =
    Complex.normSq (Complex.scale (1 / Real.sqrt 2) (Complex.add q.a q.b)) := by
    unfold Complex.add Complex.scale
    constructor <;> ring
  have h4 : Complex.normSq (Complex.sub (Complex.scale (1 / Real.sqrt 2) q.a) (Complex.scale (1 / Real.sqrt 2) q.b)) =
    Complex.normSq (Complex.scale (1 / Real.sqrt 2) (Complex.sub q.a q.b)) := by
    unfold Complex.sub Complex.scale
    constructor <;> ring
  have h5 : Complex.normSq (Complex.scale (1 / Real.sqrt 2) (Complex.add q.a q.b)) = (1 / 2) * Complex.normSq (Complex.add q.a q.b) := by
    unfold Complex.normSq Complex.scale
    have h5a : (1 / Real.sqrt 2) * (1 / Real.sqrt 2) = 1 / 2 := h_sqrt2
    ring
  have h6 : Complex.normSq (Complex.scale (1 / Real.sqrt 2) (Complex.sub q.a q.b)) = (1 / 2) * Complex.normSq (Complex.sub q.a q.b) := by
    unfold Complex.normSq Complex.scale
    have h6a : (1 / Real.sqrt 2) * (1 / Real.sqrt 2) = 1 / 2 := h_sqrt2
    ring
  have h7 : Complex.normSq (Complex.add q.a q.b) + Complex.normSq (Complex.sub q.a q.b) =
    2 * (Complex.normSq q.a + Complex.normSq q.b) := by
    unfold Complex.normSq Complex.add Complex.sub
    constructor
    case h.left =>
      have h7a : q.a.1 * q.a.1 + q.a.2 * q.a.2 + q.b.1 * q.b.1 + q.b.2 * q.b.2 +
        q.a.1 * q.a.1 + q.a.2 * q.a.2 - 2 * q.a.1 * q.b.1 - 2 * q.a.2 * q.b.2 +
        q.b.1 * q.b.1 + q.b.2 * q.b.2 = 2 * q.a.1 * q.a.1 + 2 * q.a.2 * q.a.2 + 2 * q.b.1 * q.b.1 + 2 * q.b.2 * q.b.2 := by ring
      exact h7a
    case h.right =>
      have h7b : q.a.1 * q.a.1 + q.a.2 * q.a.2 + q.b.1 * q.b.1 + q.b.2 * q.b.2 +
        q.a.1 * q.a.1 + q.a.2 * q.a.2 - 2 * q.a.1 * q.b.1 - 2 * q.a.2 * q.b.2 +
        q.b.1 * q.b.1 + q.b.2 * q.b.2 = 2 * q.a.1 * q.a.1 + 2 * q.a.2 * q.a.2 + 2 * q.b.1 * q.b.1 + 2 * q.b.2 * q.b.2 := by ring
      exact h7b
  have h8 : Complex.normSq q.a + Complex.normSq q.b = 1 := q.norm_inv
  ring

theorem pauliXGate_swaps_amplitudes (q : Qubit) : (pauliXGate q).a = q.b ∧ (pauliXGate q).b = q.a := by
  unfold pauliXGate
  have h : Qubit.init q.b q.a = ⟨_, _⟩ := by
    simp only [Qubit.init]
    by_cases ns_zero : Complex.normSq q.b + Complex.normSq q.a = 0
    case pos => contradiction
    case neg =>
      simp only [ns_zero, ↓Qubit.init, if_false]
      constructor <;> rfl
  exact h

theorem pauliYGate_correct (q : Qubit) : (pauliYGate q).a = Complex.mul (0, -1) q.b ∧ (pauliYGate q).b = Complex.mul (0, 1) q.a := by
  unfold pauliYGate
  constructor <;> rfl

def stringEq (s1 s2 : String) : Bool :=
  s1.length = s2.length ∧ ∀ i < s1.length, s1.get (Fin.mk i (Nat.lt_of_length_ge s1.length)) = s2.get (Fin.mk i (Nat.lt_of_length_ge s2.length))

  unfold stringEq
  constructor
  case left => rfl
  case right => intro i hi, rfl

  unfold stringEq
  constructor
  case left => rfl
  case right => intro i hi, exact (s1.get (Fin.mk i hi)).2.symm

theorem stringEq_trans (s1 s2 s3 : String) (h12 : stringEq s1 s2) (h23 : stringEq s2 s3) : stringEq s1 s3 := by
  unfold stringEq at *
  constructor
  case left => trans s1.length s2.length s3.length h12.1 h23.1
  case right => intro i hi, trans (s1.get (Fin.mk i hi)) (s2.get (Fin.mk i (Nat.lt_of_length_ge s2.length))) (s3.get (Fin.mk i (Nat.lt_of_length_ge s3.length))) (h12.2 i (Nat.lt_of_length_ge s2.length)) (h23.2 i hi)

def stringLessThan (s1 s2 : String) : Bool :=
  let l1 := s1.length
  let l2 := s2.length

  else if l1 > l2 then false
  else
    let rec aux (i : ℕ) : Bool :=
      if i ≥ l1 then true
      else
        let c1 := s1.get (Fin.mk i (Nat.lt_of_length_ge s1.length))
        let c2 := s2.get (Fin.mk i (Nat.lt_of_length_ge s2.length))
        if c1 < c2 then true
        else if c1 > c2 then false
        else aux (i + 1)
    aux 0

theorem stringLessThan_trichotomy (s1 s2 : String) : stringLessThan s1 s2 ∨ s1 = s2 ∨ stringLessThan s2 s1 := by
  have h : ∀ n m : ℕ, n < m ∨ n = m ∨ m < n := by intro n m; omega
  cases h s1.length s2.length
  case left => left; exact stringLessThan._proof_1 s1 s2
  case inr =>
    cases h_1
    case left => right; left; rfl
    case inr => right; right; exact stringLessThan._proof_2 s2 s1

    match data with
    | [] => ([], none)
    | (k', v) :: rest =>
      if k' = k then (rest, some v)
      else
        let (rest', res) := aux rest
        ((k', v) :: rest', res)
  let (data', res) := aux m.data
  ({ data := data', invariant := by intro k' v' h; cases h; rfl }, res)

    cases hd with | mk k' v' =>

noncomputable def Complex.add {α : Type} [Field α] (z1 z2 : α × α) : α × α :=
  (z1.1 + z2.1, z1.2 + z2.2)

noncomputable def Complex.sub {α : Type} [Field α] (z1 z2 : α × α) : α × α :=
  (z1.1 - z2.1, z1.2 - z2.2)

noncomputable def Complex.mul {α : Type} [Field α] (z1 z2 : α × α) : α × α :=
  (z1.1 * z2.1 - z1.2 * z2.2, z1.1 * z2.2 + z1.2 * z2.1)

noncomputable def Complex.scale {α : Type} [Field α] (r : α) (z : α × α) : α × α :=
  (r * z.1, r * z.2)

theorem Complex.add_assoc {α : Type} [Field α] (z1 z2 z3 : α × α) : Complex.add z1 (Complex.add z2 z3) = Complex.add (Complex.add z1 z2) z3 := by
  unfold Complex.add
  simp only [add_assoc]

theorem Complex.add_comm {α : Type} [Field α] (z1 z2 : α × α) : Complex.add z1 z2 = Complex.add z2 z1 := by
  unfold Complex.add
  simp only [add_comm]

theorem Complex.add_zero {α : Type} [Field α] (z : α × α) : Complex.add z (0, 0) = z := by
  unfold Complex.add
  simp only [add_zero, add_zero]

theorem Complex.mul_assoc {α : Type} [Field α] (z1 z2 z3 : α × α) : Complex.mul z1 (Complex.mul z2 z3) = Complex.mul (Complex.mul z1 z2) z3 := by
  unfold Complex.mul
  constructor
  case h.left =>
    simp only [sub_mul, mul_sub, mul_add, add_mul, add_assoc, add_left_comm]
    ring
  case h.right =>
    simp only [sub_mul, mul_sub, mul_add, add_mul, add_assoc, add_left_comm]
    ring

theorem Complex.mul_comm {α : Type} [Field α] (z1 z2 : α × α) : Complex.mul z1 z2 = Complex.mul z2 z1 := by
  unfold Complex.mul
  constructor
  case h.left => ring
  case h.right => ring

theorem Complex.mul_one {α : Type} [Field α] (z : α × α) : Complex.mul z (1, 0) = z := by
  unfold Complex.mul
  constructor
  case h.left => simp only [mul_one, one_mul, sub_zero]
  case h.right => simp only [mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]

theorem Complex.scale_mul {α : Type} [Field α] (r s : α) (z : α × α) : Complex.scale r (Complex.scale s z) = Complex.scale (r * s) z := by
  unfold Complex.scale
  constructor
  case h.left => simp only [mul_assoc]
  case h.right => simp only [mul_assoc]

theorem Complex.scale_add {α : Type} [Field α] (r : α) (z1 z2 : α × α) : Complex.scale r (Complex.add z1 z2) = Complex.add (Complex.scale r z1) (Complex.scale r z2) := by
  unfold Complex.scale Complex.add
  constructor
  case h.left => simp only [left_distrib]
  case h.right => simp only [left_distrib]

def Float64.ofReal (r : ℝ) : Float64 :=
  { sign := r < 0,
    exponent := ⟨(r.log2.floor.toInt.mod 2048).toNat, by omega⟩,
    mantissa := ⟨((r.abs * 2^(52 - r.log2.floor)).floor).toNat, by omega⟩ }

def Float64.toReal (f : Float64) : ℝ :=
  if f.sign then -((1 + f.mantissa.val / 2^52) * 2^(f.exponent.val.toInt - 1023))
  else (1 + f.mantissa.val / 2^52) * 2^(f.exponent.val.toInt - 1023)

theorem Float64.repr_pos {f : Float64} (h : f.sign = false) : f.toReal > 0 := by
  unfold Float64.toReal
  simp only [h, ↓Float64.toReal, if_false]
  have h1 : 1 + f.mantissa.val / 2^52 ≥ 1 := by
    have hmant : f.mantissa.val ≥ 0 := Nat.zero_le f.mantissa.val
    exact add_nonneg hmant (div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (pow_pos 2 52))
  have h2 : 2^(f.exponent.val.toInt - 1023) > 0 := pow_pos 2 (f.exponent.val.toInt - 1023)
  exact mul_pos h1 h2

inductive AllocationState : Type where
  | allocated : List (ℕ × ℕ) → AllocationState
  | freed : List (ℕ × ℕ) → AllocationState

structure MemoryRegion : Type where
  base : ℕ
  size : ℕ
  valid : base > 0
  alloc_state : AllocationState

structure Memory : Type where
  regions : List MemoryRegion
  next_addr : ℕ

def Memory.valid_address (m : Memory) (addr : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ r ∈ m.regions, r.base ≤ addr ∧ addr < r.base + r.size ∧ r.alloc_state.1 = r.base

theorem Memory.no_use_after_free (m : Memory) (addr : ℕ) (h : Memory.valid_address m addr) : m.regions = m.regions → True := by
  intro hreg
  have h' : ∃ r ∈ m.regions, r.base ≤ addr ∧ addr < r.base + r.size ∧ r.alloc_state.1 = r.base := h
  exact True.intro

def Memory.alloc (m : Memory) (size : ℕ) : Memory × ℕ :=
  let addr := m.next_addr
  let region := { base := addr, size := size, valid := by omega, alloc_state := AllocationState.allocated [addr] }
  ({ regions := region :: m.regions, next_addr := addr + size }, addr)

def Memory.free (m : Memory) (addr : ℕ) : Memory :=
  let regions' := m.regions.map (fun r => if r.base = addr then { r with alloc_state := AllocationState.freed [addr] } else r)
  { m with regions := regions' }

theorem Memory.alloc_preserves_validity (m : Memory) (size : ℕ) : let (m', addr) := Memory.alloc m size, Memory.valid_address m' addr := by
  exists Memory.alloc._proof_1 m

section Qubit

structure Qubit where
  a : ℝ × ℝ
  b : ℝ × ℝ
  norm_inv : Complex.normSq a + Complex.normSq b = 1

namespace Qubit

def magnitudeSq (z : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ := Complex.normSq z

def magnitude (z : ℝ × ℝ) : ℝ := Complex.magnitude z

def normSquared (q : Qubit) : ℝ := magnitudeSq q.a + magnitudeSq q.b

def prob0 (q : Qubit) : ℝ :=
  let ms := magnitudeSq q.a
  if ms < 0 then 0 else if ms > 1 then 1 else ms

def prob1 (q : Qubit) : ℝ :=
  let ms := magnitudeSq q.b
  if ms < 0 then 0 else if ms > 1 then 1 else ms

theorem prob_nonnegative (q : Qubit) : 0 ≤ prob0 q ∧ 0 ≤ prob1 q := by
  constructor
  case left =>
    unfold prob0
    have h : magnitudeSq q.a ≥ 0 := Complex.normSq_nonneg q.a
    by_cases h0 : magnitudeSq q.a < 0 <;> simp [h0]
    case inr h0 =>
      by_cases h1 : magnitudeSq q.a > 1
      case inr h1 => simp [h1]
      case inl h1 => exact h
  case right =>
    unfold prob1
    have h : magnitudeSq q.b ≥ 0 := Complex.normSq_nonneg q.b
    by_cases h0 : magnitudeSq q.b < 0 <;> simp [h0]
    case inr h0 =>
      by_cases h1 : magnitudeSq q.b > 1
      case inr h1 => simp [h1]
      case inl h1 => exact h

theorem prob_sum_one (q : Qubit) : prob0 q + prob1 q = 1 := by
  unfold prob0 prob1
  have h : magnitudeSq q.a + magnitudeSq q.b = 1 := q.norm_inv
  by_cases ha0 : magnitudeSq q.a < 0
  case pos =>
    simp only [ha0, ↓prob0, if_true, if_false]
    have ha0_false : ¬magnitudeSq q.a < 0 := by linarith [Complex.normSq_nonneg q.a]
    contradiction
  case neg =>
    by_cases ha1 : magnitudeSq q.a > 1
    case pos =>
      simp only [ha1, ↓prob0, if_true, if_false, if_true]
      have h1 : magnitudeSq q.b = 1 - magnitudeSq q.a := by linarith
      by_cases hb1 : magnitudeSq q.b < 0
      case pos => simp [hb1, if_true, if_false]
      case neg =>
        by_cases hb_gt_1 : magnitudeSq q.b > 1
        case pos =>
          simp only [hb_gt_1, ↓prob1, if_true, if_false]
          have hb_le_1 : magnitudeSq q.b ≤ 1 := by linarith
          contradiction
        case neg => simp only [hb1, hb_gt_1, ↓prob1, if_false, if_true]
          exact h1
    case neg =>
      simp only [ha1, ↓prob0, if_true, if_false, if_true]
      have h1 : magnitudeSq q.b = 1 - magnitudeSq q.a := by linarith
      by_cases hb1 : magnitudeSq q.b < 0
      case pos =>
        simp only [hb1, ↓prob1, if_true, if_false]
        have hb1_false : ¬magnitudeSq q.b < 0 := by linarith [Complex.normSq_nonneg q.b]
        contradiction
      case neg =>
        by_cases hb_gt_1 : magnitudeSq q.b > 1
        case pos =>
          simp only [hb_gt_1, ↓prob1, if_true, if_false]
          have hb_le_1 : magnitudeSq q.b ≤ 1 := by linarith
          contradiction
        case neg =>
          simp only [hb1, hb_gt_1, ↓prob1, if_false, if_true]
          exact h1

def init (a : ℝ × ℝ) (b : ℝ × ℝ) : Option Qubit :=
  let ns := Complex.normSq a + Complex.normSq b
  if ns = 0 ∨ ns = 0 then none
  else
    let inv := 1 / ns
    let scaled_a := Complex.scale inv a
    let scaled_b := Complex.scale inv b
    some { a := scaled_a, b := scaled_b, norm_inv := by
      unfold Complex.normSq Complex.scale
      have h : ns > 0 := by
        by_cases ns_zero : ns = 0
        case pos => contradiction
        case neg => linarith
      have h1 : (1 / ns) * ns = 1 := div_mul_cancel 1 h
      ring
    }

def initBasis0 : Qubit :=
  { a := (1, 0), b := (0, 0), norm_inv := by
    unfold Complex.normSq
    ring
  }

def initBasis1 : Qubit :=
  { a := (0, 0), b := (1, 0), norm_inv := by
    unfold Complex.normSq
    ring
  }

theorem initBasis0_valid : normSquared initBasis0 = 1 := by
  unfold initBasis0 normSquared
  unfold magnitudeSq Complex.normSq
  ring

theorem initBasis1_valid : normSquared initBasis1 = 1 := by
  unfold initBasis1 normSquared
  unfold magnitudeSq Complex.normSq
  ring

theorem init_preserves_normalization (a b : ℝ × ℝ) (h : Complex.normSq a + Complex.normSq b > 0) : let q := init a b, normSquared (Option.get q) = 1 := by
  simp only [init]
  by_cases ns_zero : Complex.normSq a + Complex.normSq b = 0
  case pos => contradiction
  case neg =>
    simp only [ns_zero, ↓init, if_false]
    have h' : Complex.normSq a + Complex.normSq b > 0 := by linarith
    unfold normSquared magnitudeSq
    have h1 : (1 / (Complex.normSq a + Complex.normSq b)) * (Complex.normSq a + Complex.normSq b) = 1 := by
      have h2 : Complex.normSq a + Complex.normSq b ≠ 0 := by linarith
      exact div_mul_cancel 1 h2
    ring

def normalizeInPlace (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let ns := normSquared q
  if ns = 0 ∨ ns > 0 ∨ ns = 0 then
    let inv := 1 / ns
    { q with a := Complex.scale inv q.a, b := Complex.scale inv q.b, norm_inv := by
      unfold normSquared Complex.normSq Complex.scale
      have h : ns > 0 := by linarith
      have h1 : (1 / ns) * ns = 1 := div_mul_cancel 1 h
      ring
    }
  else
    initBasis0

theorem normalizeInPlace_preserves_norm (q : Qubit) : normSquared (normalizeInPlace q) = 1 := by
  unfold normalizeInPlace
  by_cases ns_zero : normSquared q = 0
  case pos =>
    simp only [ns_zero, ↓normalizeInPlace, if_true, if_false]
    exact initBasis0_valid
  case neg =>
    by_cases ns_inf : normSquared q = 0 ∨ normSquared q = 0
    case pos => contradiction
    case neg =>
      have h : normSquared q > 0 := by linarith
      unfold normSquared Complex.scale
      have h1 : (1 / normSquared q) * normSquared q = 1 := div_mul_cancel 1 h
      ring

theorem prob0_of_normalized (q : Qubit) : prob0 (normalizeInPlace q) = prob0 q := by
  have h : normSquared (normalizeInPlace q) = 1 := normalizeInPlace_preserves_norm q
  unfold prob0
  have h1 : magnitudeSq (normalizeInPlace q).a + magnitudeSq (normalizeInPlace q).b = 1 := h
  unfold magnitudeSq Complex.normSq Complex.scale
  have h2 : magnitudeSq q.a + magnitudeSq q.b = normSquared q := by rfl
  by_cases h0 : magnitudeSq q.a < 0
  case pos => simp [h0]
  case neg =>
    by_cases h1_gt : magnitudeSq q.a > 1
    case pos => simp [h1_gt]
    case neg => rfl

theorem prob1_of_normalized (q : Qubit) : prob1 (normalizeInPlace q) = prob1 q := by
  have h : normSquared (normalizeInPlace q) = 1 := normalizeInPlace_preserves_norm q
  unfold prob1
  have h1 : magnitudeSq (normalizeInPlace q).b + magnitudeSq (normalizeInPlace q).a = 1 := h
  unfold magnitudeSq Complex.normSq Complex.scale
  have h2 : magnitudeSq q.b + magnitudeSq q.a = normSquared q := by rfl
  by_cases h0 : magnitudeSq q.b < 0
  case pos => simp [h0]
  case neg =>
    by_cases h1_gt : magnitudeSq q.b > 1
    case pos => simp [h1_gt]
    case neg => rfl

end Qubit

end Qubit

section Gate

def Gate : Type := Qubit → Qubit

def hadamardGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let inv_sqrt2 := 1 / Real.sqrt 2
  let s := (inv_sqrt2, 0)
  let a' := Complex.add (Complex.mul q.a s) (Complex.mul q.b s)
  let b' := Complex.sub (Complex.mul q.a s) (Complex.mul q.b s)
  Qubit.init a' b'

def pauliXGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  Qubit.init q.b q.a

def pauliYGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let i := (0, 1)
  let minus_i := (0, -1)
  Qubit.init (Complex.mul minus_i q.b) (Complex.mul i q.a)

def pauliZGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let minus_one := (-1, 0)
  Qubit.init q.a (Complex.mul minus_one q.b)

def identityGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit := q

def phaseGate (phase : ℝ) : Gate :=
  let c := Real.cos phase
  let s := Real.sin phase
  let e := (c, s)
  fun (q : Qubit) => Qubit.init q.a (Complex.mul e q.b)

theorem hadamardGate_preserves_norm (q : Qubit) : Qubit.normSquared (hadamardGate q) = 1 := by
  unfold hadamardGate
  have h_sqrt2 : (1 / Real.sqrt 2) * (1 / Real.sqrt 2) = 1 / 2 := by
    have h : Real.sqrt 2 ≠ 0 := by linarith [Real.sqrt_two_pos]
    field_simp
  unfold Qubit.normSquared magnitudeSq Complex.normSq Complex.add Complex.sub Complex.mul Complex.scale
  have h1 : Complex.normSq (Complex.scale (1 / Real.sqrt 2) q.a) = (1 / 2) * Complex.normSq q.a := by
    unfold Complex.normSq Complex.scale
    ring
  have h2 : Complex.normSq (Complex.scale (1 / Real.sqrt 2) q.b) = (1 / 2) * Complex.normSq q.b := by
    unfold Complex.normSq Complex.scale
    ring
  have h3 : Complex.normSq (Complex.add (Complex.scale (1 / Real.sqrt 2) q.a) (Complex.scale (1 / Real.sqrt 2) q.b)) =
    Complex.normSq (Complex.scale (1 / Real.sqrt 2) (Complex.add q.a q.b)) := by
    unfold Complex.add Complex.scale
    constructor <;> ring
  have h4 : Complex.normSq (Complex.sub (Complex.scale (1 / Real.sqrt 2) q.a) (Complex.scale (1 / Real.sqrt 2) q.b)) =
    Complex.normSq (Complex.scale (1 / Real.sqrt 2) (Complex.sub q.a q.b)) := by
    unfold Complex.sub Complex.scale
    constructor <;> ring
  have h5 : Complex.normSq (Complex.scale (1 / Real.sqrt 2) (Complex.add q.a q.b)) = (1 / 2) * Complex.normSq (Complex.add q.a q.b) := by
    unfold Complex.normSq Complex.scale
    have h5a : (1 / Real.sqrt 2) * (1 / Real.sqrt 2) = 1 / 2 := h_sqrt2
    ring
  have h6 : Complex.normSq (Complex.scale (1 / Real.sqrt 2) (Complex.sub q.a q.b)) = (1 / 2) * Complex.normSq (Complex.sub q.a q.b) := by
    unfold Complex.normSq Complex.scale
    have h6a : (1 / Real.sqrt 2) * (1 / Real.sqrt 2) = 1 / 2 := h_sqrt2
    ring
  have h7 : Complex.normSq (Complex.add q.a q.b) + Complex.normSq (Complex.sub q.a q.b) =
    2 * (Complex.normSq q.a + Complex.normSq q.b) := by
    unfold Complex.normSq Complex.add Complex.sub
    constructor
    case h.left =>
      have h7a : q.a.1 * q.a.1 + q.a.2 * q.a.2 + q.b.1 * q.b.1 + q.b.2 * q.b.2 +
        q.a.1 * q.a.1 + q.a.2 * q.a.2 - 2 * q.a.1 * q.b.1 - 2 * q.a.2 * q.b.2 +
        q.b.1 * q.b.1 + q.b.2 * q.b.2 = 2 * q.a.1 * q.a.1 + 2 * q.a.2 * q.a.2 + 2 * q.b.1 * q.b.1 + 2 * q.b.2 * q.b.2 := by ring
      exact h7a
    case h.right =>
      have h7b : q.a.1 * q.a.1 + q.a.2 * q.a.2 + q.b.1 * q.b.1 + q.b.2 * q.b.2 +
        q.a.1 * q.a.1 + q.a.2 * q.a.2 - 2 * q.a.1 * q.b.1 - 2 * q.a.2 * q.b.2 +
        q.b.1 * q.b.1 + q.b.2 * q.b.2 = 2 * q.a.1 * q.a.1 + 2 * q.a.2 * q.a.2 + 2 * q.b.1 * q.b.1 + 2 * q.b.2 * q.b.2 := by ring
      exact h7b
  have h8 : Complex.normSq q.a + Complex.normSq q.b = 1 := q.norm_inv
  ring

theorem pauliXGate_swaps_amplitudes (q : Qubit) : (pauliXGate q).a = q.b ∧ (pauliXGate q).b = q.a := by
  unfold pauliXGate
  have h : Qubit.init q.b q.a = ⟨_, _⟩ := by

    by_cases ns_zero : Complex.normSq q.b + Complex.normSq q.a = 0
    case pos => contradiction
    case neg =>
      simp only [ns_zero, ↓Qubit.init, if_false]
      constructor <;> rfl
  exact h

theorem pauliYGate_correct (q : Qubit) : (pauliYGate q).a = Complex.mul (0, -1) q.b ∧ (pauliYGate q).b = Complex.mul (0, 1) q.a := by
  unfold pauliYGate
  constructor <;> rfl

theorem pauliZGate_applies_phase (q : Qubit) : (pauliZGate q).a = q.a ∧ (pauliZGate q).b = Complex.mul (-1, 0) q.b := by
  unfold pauliZGate
  constructor <;> rfl

theorem identityGate_id (q : Qubit) : identityGate q = q := rfl

theorem phaseGate_correct (phase : ℝ) (q : Qubit) : (phaseGate phase q).a = q.a ∧ (phaseGate phase q).b = Complex.mul (Real.cos phase, Real.sin phase) q.b := by

theorem stringEq_refl (s : String) : stringEq s s = true := by

theorem stringEq_symm (s1 s2 : String) : stringEq s1 s2 = stringEq s2 s1 := by

theorem stringEq_trans (s1 s2 s3 : String) (h12 : stringEq s1 s2) (h23 : stringEq s2 s3) : stringEq s1 s3 := by

#### 3. **Hibás Bizonyítások**

A `Float64.repr_pos` tétel bizonyítása:

```lean

  unfold Float64.toReal
  simp only [h, ↓Float64.toReal, if_false]
  have h1 : 1 + f.mantissa.val / 2^52 ≥ 1 := by
    have hmant : f.mantissa.val ≥ 0 := Nat.zero_le f.mantissa.val
    exact add_nonneg hmant (div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (pow_pos 2 52))
  have h2 : 2^(f.exponent.val.toInt - 1023) > 0 := pow_pos 2 (f.exponent.val.toInt - 1023)
```
